units.source_text: 幕间休息，观众登了上来。

en.t: During the intermission, the audience came up.

units.source_text: 这里也可以说是观看公园人群的散步场所。

en.t: This place could also be called a strolling spot from which to watch the people in the park.

units.source_text: 不过，镶玻璃的房间只有楼梯口的一间，

en.t: However, there was only one glass-fronted room by the stairway,

units.source_text: 一大片混凝土空地，町子踩着混凝土粗糙的地面，朝着相当于戏棚后面的方向走去。

en.t: Across a broad concrete open space, Machiko stepped over the rough concrete ground and walked toward what would be the back of the theater shed.

units.source_text: 因为她想着后面的藤萝架下的长椅子上，新恋人少年会不会坐在那里呢？

en.t: Perhaps she was wondering whether the young boy who was her new lover might be sitting on the bench beneath the wisteria trellis in the back.
But she came up against the lighting room.

units.source_text: 这里正好是舞台的正上方。

en.t: This was directly above the stage.

units.source_text: 配光室的后面是后台的寝室。

en.t: Behind the lighting room was the backstage sleeping room.
The sleeping room was on the third floor.
The second floor was the backstage area.
